about.description: Equity-index perpetual market tracking a U.S. technology-heavy public-equity benchmark. Users get synthetic index exposure rather than ownership of constituent shares. Pricing follows the market reference used by the km venue on Hyperliquid. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the km namespace, but are operated by Markets by Kinetiq rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
